title: Add factorial(int n) + JUnit test
body:
Add `public static long factorial(int n)` on `MathUtils` (n<=20). 0!=1. Negative input throws IllegalArgumentException. Add `MathUtilsTest.factorial_*` JUnit cases.

## Allowed files
- src/main/java/com/example/MathUtils.java
- src/test/java/com/example/MathUtilsTest.java
